name: Inter Company Stock Transfer | Multi Company Stock Transfer
description:
The Multi-Company Inventory Transfer app allows users to efficiently transfer stock between multiple companies, streamlining inventory management in a multi-company setup. 
    With this app, users can facilitate stock transfers between different companies, ensuring products are available at the right locations. 
    It also provides a feature to check product availability in source locations, ensuring smooth transfers. Additionally, the app helps manage delivery orders for both incoming and outgoing stock, 
    providing better control over the entire inventory process across various companies.
